title: Us vs Them
idea: Brief #22 H+S: Price-escalation offer opener ("When I dropped the price, you didn't buy it...") into mechanism proof (cream sits on top vs castor oil soaks in, X over the cheap plastic Amazon bottle), modelled on the reference.

script.script: When I dropped the price, you didn't buy it. When I added free shipping, you still didn't care. Well, guess what?

script.script:
Now it's 50% off plus a free bottle. Free shipping. And 30 nights or your money back, even if you use the whole thing.
No ten-step routine. No 80-dollar night cream. You roll it on before bed: forehead, between your brows, under your eyes. Two minutes and you're done.
Castor oil is about 85% ricinoleic acid, so instead of sitting on top like a cream, it soaks in and holds moisture all night. That's why your skin looks smoother by morning.
Look at this. Organic, cold-pressed, hexane-free, poured straight into dark amber glass the day it's pressed. Not the cheap castor oil that sits in plastic drums for months before it's ever bottled.
Over 43,000 women already roll it on every night, and this bundle keeps selling out.
Don't wait until it's gone to start caring about your skin. Grab yours now. Link below.

editing_notes:
Replicate this format: Reference (link above). 40 to 50 seconds. Open on the price escalation over hands holding the product (kitchen counter, then an open shipping box, then outdoors), with a fixed top banner. Then switch to proof: AI cross-section of skin (cream sitting on top vs castor oil soaking in), a smiling woman in her 50s rolling it under her eyes, a lab-style macro of the oil, an Amazon-style generic plastic bottle with a big white X, and shelves with a few bottles left. Bold word-by-word captions with one red-highlighted word. B-roll (UGC & AI): unboxing, hands with bottle in 4 locations, skin cross-section animation, oil in plastic drums vs amber glass, woman rolling under the eyes and between the brows, near-empty shelf.

Variations needed: Hooks: 3. Total Ads: 3.

Voiceover: Average American female, 40s to 50s, confident and a little cheeky, like she's calling the viewer out in a friendly way. Fast on the offer, slower on the product.
NEEDS TO HAVE CONVICTION in their voice, its boring to listen to a dull script. They need to speak with character.

Avatar: Hands-only POV for the offer section (woman in her 50s), then a real-looking woman 55 to 65 with soft lines and under-eye puffiness, smiling as she rolls it on. Product aware: she knows castor oil and has seen our ads, but hasn't bought.
